findings.evidence: Our servers may also automatically collect information about you, your online behavior and your computer, mobile or other device. findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that location data is shared with Mixpanel or any third party, but it does mention that location data is collected. There is no statement that the data is not shared.
